verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents source-map support for reversing JavaScript transformations (minification) in stack traces. Its official CLI is documented for uploading files to improve stacktraces, which covers the CLI path of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the CLI uploads JavaScript source maps specifically, any evidence of a bundler plugin (e.g. webpack/Vite), CI-pipeline usage docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
